To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. The size of the public accountant firms has a significant negative influence to mandatory disclosure, whereas the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners and directors positively influence the level mandatory disclosure, 2. The effectiveness of Board of Directors and audit committee positively influence the level voluntary disclosure,

The size of public accounting firms has a significant negative influence on the level of voluntary disclosures; the size of public accounting firm has no significant effect on the level mandatory disclosures.

The size of the public accountant firm has a significant effect on the level mandatory disclosure, the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners, directors, and audit committee have a significant effect on mandatory disclosure, the size of public accountant firm has no significant effect on the voluntary disclosure, the effectiveness the Board of Commissioners and directors have a significant effect voluntary disclosure, the size public accountant firm and the effectiveness of the audit committee have no significant effect voluntary disclosure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of the board of directors, audit committee, and audit firm size on the voluntary disclosure.
the influence of the effectiveness of audit committee and board of commissioners on the level of disclosure.
the effect of board of directors, board of commissioner, audit committee, and external audit on the mandatory and voluntary disclosure of Indonesian public listed companies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the effectiveness of the audit committees and the directors have a positive effect on mandatory and voluntary disclosure, while the size of the accounting firms and external audit have a negative effect on mandatory disclosure.
the audit committee and the effectiveness of the external audit have no influence on the level of voluntary disclosures.
the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners, the effectiveness of Directors and the effectiveness of the Audit Committee have a positive effect on the level mandatory disclosure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the board of commissioners has a significant positive effect on the level mandatory disclosure, while audit committee and external audit have no significant effect on the level voluntary disclosure.
the effectiveness of the audit committee, the board of directors and external audit has no significant effect on the level voluntary disclosure.
the board of commissioners effectiveness, directors effectiveness, audit committee effectiveness, and the external audit (audit opinion) have positive influence on the level of voluntary disclosures.
